1.text: Uwiteka agenderera Sara nk'uko yavuze, Uwiteka agirira Sara ibyo yasezeranije.

2.text: Sara asama inda ya Aburahamu ashaje, babyarana umuhungu igihe Imana yamubwiye kigeze.

3.text: Aburahamu yita umuhungu yabyaye Isaka, uwo yabyaranye na Sara.

4.text: Aburahamu akeba Isaka umuhungu we amaze iminsi munani avutse, uko Imana yamutegetse.

5.text: Aburahamu yabyaye uwo muhungu we Isaka, amaze imyaka ijana avutse.

6.text: Sara aravuga ati “Imana iranshekeje, abazabyumva bose bazasekana nanjye.”

7.text: Ati “Ni nde uba warabwiye Aburahamu yuko Sara azonsa abana? Ko mubyariye umuhungu ashaje.”

8.text: Umwana arakura aracuka, ku munsi Isaka yacukiyeho Aburahamu ararika abantu benshi arabagaburira.

9.text: Sara abona umuhungu wa Hagari Umunyegiputakazi, uwo yabyaranye na Aburahamu, abaseka.

10.text: Ni cyo cyatumye abwira Aburahamu ati “Senda uyu muja n'umuhungu we, kuko umuhungu w'uyu muja atazaraganwa n'umuhungu wanjye Isaka.”

11.text: Ibyo by'uwo muhungu we bitera Aburahamu agahinda kenshi.

12.text: Imana ibwira Aburahamu iti “We kugirira uwo muhungu agahinda n'umuja wawe, ibyo Sara akubwira byose umwumvire, kuko kuri Isaka ari ho urubyaro ruzakwitirirwa.

13.text: Kandi umuhungu w'uwo muja na we nzamuhindura ubwoko, kuko ari urubyaro rwawe.”

14.text: Aburahamu azinduka kare kare, yenda umutsima n'imvumba y'uruhu irimo amazi, abiha Hagari abishyira ku rutugu rwe, amuha n'uwo mwana aramusenda, avayo azerera mu butayu bw'i Bērisheba.

15.text: Ya mvumba ishiramo amazi, arambika umwana munsi y'igihuru cy'aho.

16.text: Aragenda yicara amwerekeye, amuhaye intera nk'aho umuntu yarasa umwambi, kuko yibwiraga ati “Ne kureba umwana wanjye apfa.” Yicara amwerekeye atera hejuru ararira.

17.text: Imana yumva ijwi ry'uwo muhungu, marayika w'Imana ari mu ijuru, ahamagara Hagari aramubaza ati “Ubaye ute, Hagari? Witinya kuko Imana yumviye ijwi ry'uwo muhungu aho ari.

18.text: Haguruka, byutsa umuhungu umufate mu maboko, kuko nzamuhindura ubwoko bukomeye.”

19.text: Imana imuhumura amaso, abona iriba, aragenda avoma amazi yuzuye ya mvumba, ayaramiza umuhungu we.

20.text: Nuko Imana ibana n'uwo muhungu arakura, atura mu butayu, aba umurashi.

21.text: Aba mu butayu bw'i Parani, nyina amusabira Umunyegiputakazi.

22.text: Muri iyo minsi, Abimeleki na Fikoli umutware w'ingabo ze babwira Aburahamu bati “Imana iri kumwe nawe mu byo ukora byose.

23.text: Nuko rero, undahire Imana yuko utazandiganya cyangwa umwana wanjye cyangwa umwuzukuru wanjye, ahubwo ineza nakugiriye ko uzayinyitura, jyewe n'igihugu wasuhukiyemo.”

25.text: Aburahamu azimuza Abimeleki ku by'iriba, abagaragu ba Abimeleki bamunyaze.

26.text: Abimeleki aramusubiza ati “Sinzi uwakoze ibyo, nawe ntiwigeze kubimbwira, kandi sinigeze kubyumva keretse none.”

27.text: Aburahamu azana intama n'inka, abiha Abimeleki, bombi barasezerana.

28.text: Aburahamu arobanura abāgazi b'intama barindwi bo mu mukumbi we.

29.text: Abimeleki abaza Aburahamu ati “Abo bāgazi b'intama barindwi urobanuye, bisobanuye iki?”

30.text: Aramusubiza ati “Aba bāgazi b'intama uko ari barindwi, ndabaguhera kugira ngo bimbere umugabo, yuko ari jye wafukuye iryo riba.”

31.text: Ni cyo cyatumye yita aho hantu Bērisheba, kuko ari ho barahiriye bombi.

32.text: Nuko basezeranira i Bērisheba, Abimeleki ahagurukana na Fikoli umutware w'ingabo ze, basubira mu gihugu cy'Abafilisitiya.

33.text: Aburahamu atera igiti cyitwa umwesheri i Bērisheba, yambarizayo izina ry'Uwiteka, Imana ihoraho.

34.text: Aburahamu amara iminsi myinshi asuhukiye mu gihugu cy'Abafilisitiya.
